about.title: Design with intent. Code with precision.
about.p1: ATS Studio is Alexandre Terras Simões' new digital design and development studio, rooted in the city of Guarda. We work with founders, local businesses and teams who want more than a good-looking page — they want a clear, memorable digital presence built to grow.
about.p2: Every project starts with an honest conversation. We define what the brand needs to communicate, design the experience, then build it in clean, fast, maintainable code.
about.p3: Small by choice. Close to the client, always.
